findings.title: Increment the retry counter atomically
findings.body: Both failure paths write `reminder.retryCount + 1` using the value read before processing the batch. If cron invocations overlap, two failed scheduling attempts can read the same count and overwrite each other with the same incremented value. The reminder then survives more than the intended two failures. Use Prisma's atomic `increment` operation in both failure paths so each failed attempt is recorded.

findings.title: Keep retry bookkeeping failures from aborting the entire batch
findings.body: The new database update inside the catch block is itself unprotected. If a `workflowReminder.update` in the try block fails because the database is unavailable, the catch immediately attempts another update that can fail for the same reason, escaping the loop and aborting the request. A reminder deleted while scheduling is in flight similarly causes both updates to fail. Previously these per-reminder errors were logged and processing continued; now one such error prevents all remaining reminders in the batch from being attempted. Handle failures of the retry-count update separately, including reminders that no longer exist.
